UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

SELECT s.reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds
FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

) r

) r

        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (

        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

) r

SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q

    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()

) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

UPDATE products p

FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r

SELECT p0.id AS "Id", p0.name AS "Name", p0.english_name AS "EnglishName", p0.slug AS "Slug", p0.main_image AS "Image", p0.unit_price AS "UnitPrice", CASE
    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", b.name AS "BrandName", b.slug AS "BrandSlug", p0.attributes_json AS "AttributesJson", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.amazing_ends_at, p.attributes_json, p.brand_id, p.category_id, p.discount_percent, p.english_name, p.is_amazing, p.is_special, p.main_image, p.name, p.reserved_count, p.sales_count, p.slug, p.stock, p.unit_price
    FROM products AS p
    WHERE p.is_active AND p.is_amazing AND p.stock - p.reserved_count > 0 AND p.discount_percent > 0
    ORDER BY p.discount_percent DESC
    LIMIT @p
) AS p0
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p0.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN brands AS b ON p0.brand_id = b.id
ORDER BY p0.discount_percent DESC

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", b.name AS "BrandName", b.slug AS "BrandSlug", p0.attributes_json AS "AttributesJson", CASE

        SELECT 1

        WHERE p0.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)

        WHERE p0.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int

    WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE

SELECT s.reservation_cleanup_interval_seconds
FROM site_settings AS s
ORDER BY s.id
LIMIT 1

UPDATE products p
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(p.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NULL AND variant_id IS NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY product_id
) r
WHERE r.product_id = p.id

UPDATE seller_offers o
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(o.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT offer_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND offer_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY offer_id
) r
WHERE r.offer_id = o.id

UPDATE product_variants v
SET reserved_count = GREATEST(v.reserved_count - r.q, 0)
FROM (
    SELECT variant_id, SUM(quantity) AS q
    FROM stock_reservations
    WHERE status = 1 AND variant_id IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= now()
    GROUP BY variant_id
) r
WHERE r.variant_id = v.id

UPDATE stock_reservations
SET status = 3, released_at = now()
WHERE status = 1 AND expires_at <= now()

    WHEN p.discount_percent > 0 THEN p.unit_price - (p.unit_price * p.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p.stock - p.reserved_count AS "Stock", p.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p.category_id AS "CategoryId", c.name AS "CategoryName", c.slug AS "CategorySlug", b.name AS "BrandName", b.slug AS "BrandSlug", p.attributes_json AS "AttributesJson", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c0
        WHERE p.id = c0.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c1.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c1
        WHERE p.id = c1.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c2
    WHERE p.id = c2.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
FROM products AS p
INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN brands AS b ON p.brand_id = b.id
WHERE p.is_active AND p.slug = @slug
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.id, s.english_name, s.code, s.description, s.view_count, s.category_id, s.attributes_json, s.c, s.c0, s.c1, s.c2, s.c3, s.c4, s.id0, s.name, s.slug, s.id1, s.id2, p0.url, p0.id
FROM (
    SELECT p.id, p.english_name, p.code, p.description, p.view_count, p.category_id, p.attributes_json, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL AND c1.id IS NOT NULL THEN c1.id
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.id
        ELSE c.id
    END AS c, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL AND c1.id IS NOT NULL THEN c1.name
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.name
        ELSE c.name
    END AS c0, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL AND c1.id IS NOT NULL THEN c1.slug
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.slug
        ELSE c.slug
    END AS c1, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL AND c1.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.id
        ELSE c.id
    END AS c2, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL AND c1.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.name
        ELSE c.name
    END AS c3, CASE
        WHEN c0.id IS NOT NULL AND c1.id IS NOT NULL THEN c0.slug
        ELSE c.slug
    END AS c4, c.id AS id0, c.name, c.slug, c0.id AS id1, c1.id AS id2
    FROM products AS p
    INNER JOIN categories AS c ON p.category_id = c.id

    WHERE p.slug = @slug
    LIMIT 1

        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (

            ELSE s1.price

        FROM seller_offers AS s1

        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)

    WHEN p0.discount_percent > 0 THEN p0.unit_price - (p0.unit_price * p0.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
    ELSE p0.unit_price
END AS "FinalPrice", p0.discount_percent AS "DiscountPercent", p0.stock - p0.reserved_count AS "Stock", p0.is_amazing AS "IsAmazing", p0.amazing_ends_at AS "AmazingEndsAt", p0.is_special AS "IsSpecial", p0.category_id AS "CategoryId", c1.name AS "CategoryName", c1.slug AS "CategorySlug", b.name AS "BrandName", b.slug AS "BrandSlug", p0.attributes_json AS "AttributesJson", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM comments AS c2
        WHERE p0.id = c2.product_id) THEN (
        SELECT avg(c3.rating::double precision)
        FROM comments AS c3
        WHERE p0.id = c3.product_id)
    ELSE 0.0
END AS "AverageRating", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM comments AS c4
    WHERE p0.id = c4.product_id) AS "CommentCount", p0.sales_count AS "SalesCount", CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM seller_offers AS s
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s0 ON s.seller_id = s0.id
        WHERE p0.id = s.product_id AND s.is_active AND s0.status = 2 AND s0.is_active AND s.stock - s.reserved_count > 0) THEN (
        SELECT min(CASE
            WHEN s1.discount_percent > 0 THEN s1.price - (s1.price * s1.discount_percent::bigint) / 100
            ELSE s1.price
        END)
        FROM seller_offers AS s1
        INNER JOIN sellers AS s2 ON s1.seller_id = s2.id
        WHERE p0.id = s1.product_id AND s1.is_active AND s2.status = 2 AND s2.is_active AND s1.stock - s1.reserved_count > 0)
END AS "MinOfferPrice", (
    SELECT count(*)::int
    FROM seller_offers AS s3
    INNER JOIN sellers AS s4 ON s3.seller_id = s4.id
    WHERE p0.id = s3.product_id AND s3.is_active AND s4.status = 2 AND s4.is_active AND s3.stock - s3.reserved_count > 0) AS "OfferCount"
